swiftIntro: For businesses whose customers need to find them, understand them and take the next step. Cafés, shops, clubs and service businesses so far.

retroSummary: A bold identity with practical fragrance guides and a clear order-enquiry journey.
rugbySummary: A club’s personality, with clear information for players and visitors from around the world.
capheHeading: A local place. A wider welcome.
capheBrief: Càphê Commune brings coffee, breakfast and coworking together in Da Nang. Its website needed to communicate the atmosphere and make the useful details easy to find.
capheApproach: Real photography gives the website its character. Clear routes to the menu, coworking and visitor information make it useful. Five language versions welcome an international audience.
capheResult: A photographic website with an illustrated coffee menu, coworking information and practical visit details in English, Vietnamese, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Spanish.
validatorSummary: A validation tool that organises extracted information and helps reviewers focus on exceptions.
validatorBrief: Reviewing purchase-order information takes time. A useful interface needs to show what is ready, what is flagged and what needs attention.
validatorApproach: A validation layer organises the queue into clean, flagged and blocked items. Clear states support the review process while retaining human judgement.
validatorResult: Eli reports a 50% reduction in administration time for this workflow. Purchase-order administration time had been tracked across several staff in the role over a number of years; once the tool was in use, the same work took half the time. The result relates to this implementation; other workflows need their own assessment.
sampleData: UI redesign concept with illustrative sample data. No client records shown.
swiftServicesIntro: Strategy, visual design and development belong in the same conversation. Choose the support your business needs.
stackServicesTitle: Build what moves the work forward.
stackServicesIntro: Start with the problem. Agree the right scope. Build, evaluate and hand over a system your team can use.
webDesc: A bespoke business website that explains your offer and gives visitors a clear way to enquire.
webScope: Typically 5–8 pages, responsive design, one core enquiry journey, agreed content structure and technical search foundations.
flagshipDesc: A substantial website redesign, with content structure, visual direction and launch planned together.
flagshipScope: Content architecture, tailored visual direction, richer interaction and a defined migration plan. Integrations and content production are scoped before the build.
commerceDesc: Online stores designed around your products, customers and operations.
commerceScope: A bespoke storefront and setup on an agreed commerce platform: catalogue structure, product pages, mobile checkout, payment and delivery configuration, and operator training. Inventory, accounting, booking or fulfilment integrations are scoped where needed. Platform choice follows the requirements; fully custom commerce and complex integrations need discovery and a separate scope. Platform subscriptions, transaction fees and third-party costs are separate.
seoDesc: Find the technical and content changes that could help people discover your website through search and AI answers.
seoScope: An audit, prioritised action plan and walkthrough of the findings. Implementation is scoped separately. The audit covers relevant GEO and AEO opportunities; rankings and AI citations are not guaranteed. GEO means generative engine optimisation; AEO means answer engine optimisation.
careDesc: Monitoring, maintenance and an agreed allowance for smaller website changes.
careScope: Monitoring, maintenance and a specified allowance for smaller changes. Support windows, hosting and third-party costs are agreed in the proposal.
appDesc: A database-backed app for one defined workflow, with agreed users, permissions and handover.
appScope: One primary workflow with defined data, users and permissions: a database-backed app, staff workspace or client portal. Agreed migration, reporting and integration requirements, testing and operator handover. Complex migrations and multiple systems are scoped separately.
platformDesc: Connect multiple workflows, user roles and existing systems in agreed stages.
platformScope: Multiple workflows, roles or integrations, delivered in agreed milestones. Data migration, dependencies and access requirements are established in discovery.
aiDesc: Assess one AI use case, build it and evaluate it against representative tasks before wider use.
aiScope: Assess the opportunity, build a bounded use case, evaluate it against representative tasks and introduce human review and failure handling. Model usage and ongoing support are scoped separately.
consultDesc: Decide what to build, buy or change, with a systems assessment and clear recommendations.
consultScope: A defined advisory question, agreed preparation and clear recommendations. Build-versus-buy, systems assessment, AI opportunities and a practical roadmap. Implementation is a separate scope.
trainingDesc: Tailored workshops and practical exercises for the team that will use or manage the system.
trainingScope: Tailored workshops, practical exercises and working guidance for an agreed team. Consultancy helps you decide; enablement helps your team do. Neither implies an implementation engagement.
opsDesc: Monitoring, maintenance and incident triage, with agreed support hours and response targets.
opsScope: Monitoring, maintenance, incident triage and evaluation where relevant. Every plan defines support hours, response targets, included work and usage costs.
discoveryDesc: Assess the current system and agree priorities, constraints and a phased build estimate.
discoveryScope: A current-state assessment, priorities, constraints and phased scope with an implementation estimate. Useful decisions before committing to a larger build.
aiEditorialTitle: AI has changed the possibilities. The judgement still matters.
aiEditorial: The opportunity is to apply AI where it improves the work—not to add it everywhere. I can assess your systems, implement the right changes and support them, or coach your team to take ownership.
scopeTitle: A clear investment. A defined scope.

founderTitle: You work with the person who builds it.
founderSwift: I'm Eli Mitchell, the design and development lead behind SwiftSites. I lead a small, hand-picked development team, growing carefully as we take on new work. I personally steer design, technical quality and delivery, working directly with you.
founderStack: I'm Eli Mitchell. I combine traditional coding experience with a deep practical understanding of AI to design and build software around real business needs. I particularly enjoy building databases, staff systems and client-facing apps that turn scattered information into something people can use with confidence. I lead a small, hand-picked development team, growing carefully as we take on new work. I personally steer design, technical quality and delivery.
founderGlobal: My clients span four continents. I'm currently travelling and in Vietnam, working internationally and available to travel for larger projects that benefit from time on the ground.
onsiteTitle: Some projects are better understood in person.
onsiteIntro: Seeing the work happen can reveal what a requirements document misses. On-site assessments, workshops and implementation are available for suitable engagements.
onsiteDetails: Tell me where you are, what needs to change and who would be involved. We'll establish the value of a visit before agreeing scope, dates and travel arrangements.
travelNote: Available to travel for suitable larger projects. Travel and engagement terms are agreed separately.

retroBrief: Back to the 70’s & Beyond is a gift shop and coffee spot on Waiheke Island. The website brings its range and character online while helping visitors find products and ask about an order.
retroApproach: An animated hand-lettered opening, retro illustration and warm colour reflect the shop’s identity. Category price guides and a fragrance guide put practical information alongside the visual character.
retroResult: A website with product and fragrance guides, an order-enquiry builder, visit information and a mobile experience. Selected items become an email enquiry to the shop, rather than a completed online purchase.
rugbyBrief: Da Nang Guerilla Rugby Club needed an online home for its club story and clear information for new players and visiting teams.
rugbyApproach: A cinematic opening and real team photography express the club’s personality. Training information and a WhatsApp joining guide make the first steps clear, with separate enquiry routes for visiting teams, kit and sponsors.
rugbyResult: A seven-language club website with a cinematic opening, team-tour and camp enquiries, kit and sponsor enquiries, and women’s team recruitment information.
